title: EvaluationResult
description: Phase 3.2-B data contract. The output artifact of scoring an EvaluationRun. In 3.2-B, `metrics` is a deliberately EMPTY/placeholder object -- no Recall@K, MRR, TSR, evidence-equivalence, precision/recall, provenance, lifecycle, or agent-answer metric is computed or defined as a field anywhere in this schema (that is explicitly 3.2-C/D scope, per EVALUATION_CONTRACT.md and PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 21-22). This object exists now so that 3.2-C can populate `metrics` against a stable envelope (run identity, versions, status, warnings/errors, input provenance) without having to redesign the envelope once metrics land.

run_id.description: Identifies which EvaluationRun this result scores.

evaluator_version.description: Version identifier of the evaluator code that produced this result. In 3.2-B this identifies the (metric-free) envelope-only evaluator; a real value is expected once 3.2-C ships an evaluator that actually computes metrics.

metric_set_version.description: Version identifier of the metric set/definitions in force when this result was produced. In 3.2-B, records that NO metric set is yet defined (e.g. 'none -- 3.2-b placeholder'); 3.2-C introduces the first real metric_set_version.

result_status.description: NOT_EVALUATED is the expected status for every 3.2-B fixture/result, since metric computation does not exist yet. PARTIAL/COMPLETE/ERROR are reserved for when 3.2-C's evaluator runs.

metrics.description: Placeholder for future metric output. In 3.2-B this MUST be empty ({}) -- it is intentionally under-specified (no named metric properties, additionalProperties left open) so that 3.2-C can populate Recall@K, MRR, TSR, evidence-equivalent success, precision/recall/coverage, provenance/lineage/lifecycle metrics, and agent-level A/B/C accuracy deltas here without a breaking schema change. No metric field is defined or implied by this schema.

warnings.description: Non-fatal evaluation warnings (e.g. missing optional trace fields).

errors.description: Fatal evaluation errors, if result_status is ERROR.

evaluation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this evaluation result was produced.

input_artifact_refs.description: Opaque references to the artifacts this evaluation consumed, for traceability (TRACEABILITY_CONTRACT.md).
